info.title: Partner Integrations
info.description: Includes API operations for partner integrations, such as Webex, Identity Services Engine (ISE), Secure Access, and more

x-provenance.note: 4,138 operations across 2,841 paths, published by Cisco as self-contained per-operation OpenAPI 3.1.0 fragments on the DevNet CDN and consolidated here into 13 documents. Ownership verified from info.contact vmanage@cisco.com and the Cisco license URL rather than from the fetch host.
